brief:
Netanyahu appeared before an Israeli court Sunday for his 20th hearing in multiple corruption cases, Shehab Wire reported. The trial resumed after approximately seven years since legal proceedings against the Israeli prime minister first began, marking a significant continuation of the long-running judicial process.

The court sessions are unfolding amid a complex political backdrop. Netanyahu's appearances before the judge are now intersecting with his active preparations for upcoming general elections in Israel, adding another layer to the concurrent demands on the Israeli leader's time and political standing.
